name: Air Force
overview: A career in the Air Force provides individuals with a one-of-a-kind opportunity to serve their country and contribute to national security. The Indian Aviation Force's primary mission involves protecting airspace against aviation threats while collaborating with other military branches. Beyond defense, the Air Force assists during natural disasters and internal crises. The career demands rigorous training in aerospace engineering, aviation technology, combat tactics, leadership, and physical fitness.

topJobs.description: Flying and operating various aircraft, including fighter jets, transport planes, and helicopters
Inspects, repairs, and maintains aircraft systems for safety and operational readiness
Oversees aircraft movement and provides guidance on takeoff, landing, and flight routes
Gathers and analyzes information to support military operations
Manages transportation, supply, and resource distribution operations
Protects military networks from cyber threats

institutesIndia: Indian Air Force Technical College (IAFTC), Bengaluru
Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Pune
careerLadder: Excel in high school academics, particularly mathematics, physics, and physical education
Enroll in undergraduate programs (B.Tech in Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Electronics Engineering)
Participate in physical fitness activities, sports, and extracurricular pursuits
Join National Defence Academy (NDA) after 10+2 education for three-year program
Complete postgraduate programs (M.Tech in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering)
Commission as officer in Air Force with specialized role assignment
